questions.question: In the study of Addition Reactions of Alkenes, what is the authoritative chemical definition of 'Electrophilic Addition'?

options.label: C
options.text: A reaction in which an electrophile attacks an alkene π bond to form a reactive intermediate, followed by nucleophilic capture to convert one π bond into two σ bonds.

options.label: D
options.text: A regiochemical transformation where the incoming functional group attaches to the less substituted carbon of the original alkene double bond.
